title: --remove with no block says so, for a missing file and for a file without a block
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). With no instruction file, or an `AGENTS.md` that has no block, `--remove --yes` prints `jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (no JITSO block in AGENTS.md)`, exit 0, and writes nothing (the file is not created). The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout.equals: jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (no JITSO block in AGENTS.md)
jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (no JITSO block in AGENTS.md)
